---
title: "Global abundance-weighted prokaryotic taxonomy tree"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: false
editor: source
execute:
  enabled: false
---

Aggregate metagenomic contig read counts to
the 348 dereplicated MAGs; normalise within each of the 12 samples; average
the sample proportions with equal weights. This is the MAG-mapped read
composition, not genome-copy abundance or all-community read composition.
All MAGs and their assigned taxonomic nodes remain in the tree. Taxonomic
labels (including BAT asterisks) are retained verbatim. Branch lengths are
layout only, not evolutionary distances. Parent and child abundances overlap.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/mag_global_abundance_tree.qmd NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
python3 tests/test_mag_global_tree.py NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
```

```{r}
#| label: global-mag-tree
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table); library(ape); library(ggtree)
  library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel); library(scales)
})
check <- function(ok,msg) if(!isTRUE(ok)) stop(msg,call.=FALSE)
repo <- normalizePath(getwd())
source(file.path(repo,"R/figure_style.R"))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
check(length(args)==1L,"Supply a new output directory")
output <- normalizePath(args[[1]],mustWork=FALSE)
check(!file.exists(output),"Output exists; choose a new version")
data <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_DATA_ROOT",
  "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"))
input_paths <- c(taxonomy=file.path(data,"annotation/catbat/gtdb/BAT.bin2classification.txt"),
  counts=file.path(data,"quantification/mags_votu/coverage/metagenomics/coverm/output-Read_Count.tsv"),
  metadata=file.path(repo,"metadata/sample_metadata.tsv"))
hash <- function(p) substr(system2("shasum",c("-a","256",shQuote(p)),stdout=TRUE)[[1]],1,64)
input_hashes <- vapply(input_paths,hash,character(1))
taxa <- fread(input_paths[["taxonomy"]])
setnames(taxa,"# bin","MAG_ID")
taxa[,MAG_ID:=sub("[.]fasta$","",MAG_ID)]
check(nrow(taxa)==348L && !anyDuplicated(taxa$MAG_ID),"Expected 348 unique MAGs")
prefix <- c(domain="d__",phylum="p__",class="c__",order="o__",family="f__",genus="g__",species="s__")
for(rank in names(prefix)) {
  marker <- prefix[[rank]]
  taxa[[rank]] <- vapply(strsplit(taxa$lineage,";",fixed=TRUE),function(tokens) {
    hits <- tokens[startsWith(tokens,marker)]
    check(length(hits)<=1L,"Duplicate rank in source lineage")
    if(length(hits)) substring(hits,nchar(marker)+1L) else NA_character_
  },character(1))
}
check(all(taxa$domain %in% c("Bacteria","Archaea")),"Non-prokaryotic or unknown domain")
meta <- fread(input_paths[["metadata"]])
check(nrow(meta)==12L && !anyDuplicated(meta$sample_title) &&
  !anyDuplicated(meta$metagenome_run_accession),"Expected 12 unique sample mappings")
raw <- fread(input_paths[["counts"]])
check(!anyDuplicated(raw$Contig),"Duplicate contig identifiers")
raw <- raw[grepl("_MAGScoT_",Contig,fixed=TRUE)]
check(all(grepl("^[^_]+_MAGScoT_cleanbin_[0-9]+_",raw$Contig)),"Unexpected MAG contig identifier")
raw[,MAG_ID:=sub("^([^_]+_MAGScoT_cleanbin_[0-9]+)_.*$","\\1",Contig)]
check(setequal(raw$MAG_ID,taxa$MAG_ID),"Count matrix MAGs do not equal the 348-MAG catalogue")
cols <- setdiff(names(raw),c("Contig","MAG_ID"))
runs <- sub(".*(ERR[0-9]+).*","\\1",cols)
check(length(cols)==12L && !anyDuplicated(runs) &&
  setequal(runs,meta$metagenome_run_accession),"Count columns do not match the 12 samples")
check(all(vapply(raw[,..cols],function(x) all(is.finite(x)&x>=0),logical(1))),"Invalid read counts")
contig_inventory <- raw[,.(contigs=.N),by=MAG_ID]
wide <- raw[,lapply(.SD,sum),by=MAG_ID,.SDcols=cols]
counts <- melt(wide,id.vars="MAG_ID",variable.name="column",value.name="reads")
counts[,sample_title:=meta$sample_title[match(runs[match(column,cols)],meta$metagenome_run_accession)]]
counts[,column:=NULL]
totals <- counts[,.(total_reads=sum(reads)),by=sample_title]
check(all(totals$total_reads>0),"Zero sample denominator")
counts <- merge(counts,totals,by="sample_title")
counts[,proportion:=reads/total_reads]
weights <- counts[,.(mean_abundance=mean(proportion)),by=MAG_ID]
check(abs(sum(weights$mean_abundance)-1)<1e-12,"Global abundance does not sum to one")
nodes <- data.table(node_id="n000",parent=NA_character_,rank="root",taxon="All MAGs",
  display="All MAGs",phylum="Domain",depth=0L)
lookup <- new.env(parent=emptyenv())
assignments <- vector("list",nrow(taxa))
for(i in seq_len(nrow(taxa))) {
  parent <- "n000"; depth <- 0L
  for(rank in names(prefix)) {
    value <- taxa[[rank]][[i]]
    if(is.na(value)||!nzchar(value)) next
    key <- paste(parent,rank,value,sep="|")
    if(!exists(key,envir=lookup,inherits=FALSE)) {
      id <- sprintf("n%03d",nrow(nodes)); depth <- depth+1L
      group <- if(rank=="domain") "Domain" else taxa$phylum[[i]]
      if(is.na(group)||!nzchar(group)) group <- "Unclassified"
      nodes <- rbind(nodes,data.table(node_id=id,parent=parent,rank=rank,taxon=value,
        display=paste0(sub("_$","",prefix[[rank]]),value),phylum=group,depth=depth))
      assign(key,id,envir=lookup)
    }
    parent <- get(key,envir=lookup,inherits=FALSE)
    parent_key <- parent
    depth <- nodes[node_id==parent_key,depth]
  }
  assignments[[i]] <- data.table(MAG_ID=taxa$MAG_ID[[i]],assigned_node=parent)
}
assigned <- merge(rbindlist(assignments),weights,by="MAG_ID")
direct <- assigned[,.(direct_abundance=sum(mean_abundance),direct_mags=.N),by=assigned_node]
nodes <- merge(nodes,direct,by.x="node_id",by.y="assigned_node",all.x=TRUE,sort=FALSE)
nodes[is.na(direct_abundance),`:=`(direct_abundance=0,direct_mags=0L)]
nodes[,`:=`(clade_abundance=direct_abundance,clade_mags=direct_mags)]
for(d in rev(sort(unique(nodes$depth)))) {
  if(d==0L) next
  for(id in nodes[depth==d,node_id]) {
    parent_id <- nodes[node_id==id,parent]
    value <- nodes[node_id==id,.(clade_abundance,clade_mags)]
    nodes[node_id==parent_id,`:=`(clade_abundance=clade_abundance+value$clade_abundance,
      clade_mags=clade_mags+value$clade_mags)]
  }
}
check(nodes[node_id=="n000",clade_mags]==348L &&
  abs(nodes[node_id=="n000",clade_abundance]-1)<1e-12,"Root fails conservation")
check(sum(nodes$direct_mags)==348L,"Direct assignments are not a partition")
newick <- function(id) {
  children <- nodes[parent==id][order(phylum,-clade_abundance,display)]$node_id
  if(!length(children)) return(id)
  paste0("(",paste(vapply(children,newick,character(1)),collapse=","),")",id)
}
tree <- read.tree(text=paste0(newick("n000"),";"))
set.seed(913)
layout <- ggtree(tree,layout="daylight",branch.length="none")
xy <- as.data.table(layout$data)[,.(node,label,parent,x,y,isTip)]
check(setequal(xy$label,nodes$node_id),"Layout changed node identities")
xy <- merge(xy,nodes,by.x="label",by.y="node_id",suffixes=c(".tree",".tax"))
xy[,`:=`(x_rot=y,y_rot=-x)]
xy[,`:=`(x=x_rot,y=y_rot)]
edges <- merge(xy[parent.tree!=node,.(parent.tree,xend=x,yend=y,phylum,clade_abundance)],
  xy[,.(parent.tree=node,x,y)],by="parent.tree")
# Previously plotted phyla retain their fixed colours. Freeze an ordered
# extension for the additional phyla instead of collapsing them into Other.
extra_phyla <- c("Armatimonadota","Synergistota","UBP6","Gemmatimonadota",
  "Bacillota","Desulfobacterota_G","Methanobacteriota_B","Desulfobacterota_F",
  "Cloacimonadota","Caldisericota","Bdellovibrionota","Bacillota_C","JANLFM01",
  "Methanobacteriota","Sumerlaeota","KSB1","CLD3","Fermentibacterota","UBA3054",
  "Elusimicrobiota","4484-113","Moduliflexota","Fusobacteriota")
colours <- c(phage_uv_phylum_colours,
  setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(extra_phyla),"Dark 3"),extra_phyla),Domain="#666666")
check(all(nodes$phylum %in% names(colours)),"Missing phylum colour")
# Label thinning is visual only; no abundance or taxonomic nodes are filtered.
xy[,show_label:=rank %in% c("domain","phylum") | direct_abundance>=.01 |
  (rank=="family" & clade_abundance>=.025)]
xy[rank=="root",show_label:=FALSE]
xy[,label_text:=display]
xy[show_label==TRUE,label_text:=vapply(seq_len(.N),function(i) paste0(display[[i]],"\n",
  formatC(100*clade_abundance[[i]],format="f",digits=if(clade_abundance[[i]]>=.01)1 else 2),"%"),character(1))]
span_x <- diff(range(xy$x)); span_y <- diff(range(xy$y))
p <- ggplot()+
  geom_segment(data=edges,aes(x=x,y=y,xend=xend,yend=yend,colour=phylum,
    linewidth=clade_abundance),alpha=.55,lineend="round")+
  scale_linewidth_continuous(range=c(.25,2.8),transform="sqrt",guide="none")+
  geom_point(data=xy[rank!="root"],aes(x=x,y=y),shape=21,fill="white",colour="#AAA9A4",size=1.1,stroke=.2)+
  geom_point(data=xy[rank!="root"],aes(x=x,y=y,size=clade_abundance,fill=phylum),shape=21,colour="white",stroke=.3)+
  geom_point(data=xy[rank=="root"],aes(x=x,y=y),shape=21,fill="white",colour="#555555",size=2.7)+
  geom_label_repel(data=xy[show_label==TRUE],aes(x=x,y=y,label=label_text),
    seed=913,size=3.2,min.segment.length=0,segment.colour="#888888",segment.size=.22,
    box.padding=.7,point.padding=.25,
    point.size=14*sqrt(xy[show_label==TRUE,clade_abundance]/max(xy$clade_abundance)),
    force=10,force_pull=.05,max.overlaps=Inf,
    max.iter=200000,max.time=40,linewidth=0,label.padding=.18,fill="white",
    colour="#252525",lineheight=.98)+
  scale_size_area(max_size=14,breaks=c(.01,.1,.5,.8),labels=label_percent(accuracy=1),name="Mean relative abundance")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colours,guide="none")+
  scale_colour_manual(values=colours,guide="none")+
  coord_equal(xlim=range(xy$x)+c(-.12,.12)*span_x,ylim=range(xy$y)+c(-.12,.12)*span_y,clip="off")+
  theme_void(base_size=10)+theme(legend.position="bottom",plot.margin=margin(10,12,10,12))+
  guides(size=guide_legend(override.aes=list(fill="#65798F")))
dir.create(file.path(output,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(output,"tables"))
for(name in c("nodes","xy","edges","assigned","totals","counts","contig_inventory")) {
  files <- c(nodes="tree_nodes",xy="tree_layout",edges="tree_edges",assigned="deepest_assignments",
    totals="sample_denominators",counts="mag_sample_counts",contig_inventory="contig_inventory")
  fwrite(get(name),file.path(output,"tables",paste0(files[[name]],".tsv")),sep="\t")
}
fwrite(taxa,file.path(output,"tables/catalogue_rank_assignments.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(data.table(phylum=names(colours),colour=unname(colours)),file.path(output,"tables/phylum_colour_key.tsv"),sep="\t")
write.tree(tree,file.path(output,"global_taxonomy.nwk"))
ggsave(file.path(output,"figures/global_mag_abundance_tree.pdf"),p,
  device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE,width=15,height=12,units="in")
writeLines(c("Review only. Manuscript unchanged.",
  "348 dereplicated prokaryotic MAGs; 12 equally weighted metagenomic samples.",
  "Denominator: reads mapped to MAG contigs in each sample, not all sequenced reads or genome copies. This is not the vOTU denominator.",
  "Node area: mean inclusive clade abundance. Branch width: square-root abundance scale. Colour: fixed phylum palette; domain nodes neutral grey.",
  "All nodes retained. Labels: all domains/phyla, direct assignments >=1%, families >=2.5% inclusive abundance. Small grey rings mark tiny nodes.",
  "d_: domain; p_: phylum; c_: class; o_: order; f_: family; g_: genus; s_: species. BAT asterisk annotations retained as supplied.",
  "Parent and child abundances are nested, not additive. Branch lengths are layout, not sequence distances. No treatment or temporal inference.",
  capture.output(sessionInfo())),file.path(output,"REVIEW_README.txt"))
check(identical(input_hashes,vapply(input_paths,hash,character(1))),"Inputs changed during execution")
input_paths <- c(input_paths,code=file.path(repo,"analysis/mag_global_abundance_tree.qmd"),style=file.path(repo,"R/figure_style.R"))
fwrite(data.table(input=names(input_paths),path=unname(input_paths),sha256=vapply(input_paths,hash,character(1))),file.path(output,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
files <- list.files(output,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(output)+2L),sha256=vapply(files,hash,character(1))),file.path(output,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
print(nodes[rank %in% c("root","domain","phylum"),.(taxon,rank,clade_mags,clade_abundance)])
cat(nrow(nodes),"nodes;",sum(xy$show_label),"labels\n")
```
